summary: Implementation plan and diagnosis summary resolving HTTP 403: Forbidden errors on external git releases and mirrors (Codeberg, GitHub, GitLab, S3). Identified root cause as Codeberg/Forgejo blocking spoofed Chrome User-Agents without browser TLS fingerprints on redirected requests. Implemented authentic application client identifier (BlacksiteModManager/2.0.0), manual redirect chain resolution, and multi-tier curl fallback.
